Name: Ahimaaz, Father of Ahinoam
Summary: Ahimaaz is named as the father of Ahinoam, Saul's wife, and so the grandfather of Saul's children.
KeyStory: Ahimaaz's daughter married into the first royal house of Israel.
RelatedPeople: Ahinoam, Daughter of Ahimaaz; King Saul
LifeLesson: Family ties bind us into stories far larger than our own.
